title: Topology-monitorable Contrastive Learning on Dynamic Graphs

problem.claim: Applying graph contrastive learning to dynamically evolving graphs requires repeatedly updating learned embeddings, causing severe efficiency issues.

gap.claim: Most existing graph contrastive learning models are tailored to static graphs, limiting their application to dynamic graphs.

contributions.claim: IDOL is a contrastive learning framework for dynamic graph representation learning.
IDOL uses an incremental Personalized PageRank-based graph propagation process to capture topological changes and a topology-monitorable sampling strategy for graph contrastive learning.
The IDOL design provides a stated performance guarantee.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors describe IDOL as a novel contrastive learning framework for dynamic graph representation learning.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that IDOL eliminates heavy recomputation while maintaining high learning quality.
The authors report that experiments on multiple dynamic graphs show IDOL outperforming the strongest baselines on node classification tasks across various performance metrics.

narrative_sequence.summary: Graph contrastive learning is presented as an effective self-supervised approach for learning node representations.
Existing approaches mainly target static graphs, and direct use on dynamic graphs creates repeated-embedding-update efficiency problems.
IDOL addresses the problem with incremental Personalized PageRank propagation and topology-monitorable sampling.
The authors state that IDOL provides a performance guarantee and avoids heavy recomputation while maintaining learning quality.
Experiments on multiple dynamic graphs compare IDOL with strong baselines on node classification tasks.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the stated performance guarantee.
The abstract does not report experimental dataset names, metric values, or efficiency measurements.
The abstract does not describe IDOL's model architecture or sampling procedure in detail.
